residualRisks: R-2 stands unmitigated: a `bug` run executes prompts/architecture-impact.md, sdd.md and planning*.md, all of which frame the input as a feature to build. The output is a worse plan, not an error, and no test in this repository detects it. This is the difference between a useful command and a synonym, and it is deferred to separate work.

A run created by `bug` is indistinguishable from one created by `feature` in state.json, events.jsonl, request.md, `status` and the dashboard. If the intent behind the request was to see or filter bug runs in the UI, this plan does not deliver it and a persisted field (SDD A-4) plus its own SDD would be required.

FR-001/AC-001 is never exercised end to end: no test drives a `bug` run through the planning pipeline to artifacts, because the CLI hardcodes nodeAdapters() and the only alternative is spending real agent quota. Artifact parity rests entirely on the delegation argument.

The packaged-binary check for `bug` lives in scripts/packaging-smoke.mjs, which .github/workflows/ci.yml does not run (CI runs check, e2e, visual and coverage only). FR-011 therefore holds only for as long as someone keeps running `npm run test:packaging` locally.
